title: Do-Not-Answer: A Dataset for Evaluating Safeguards in LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM responses to risky instruction templates specifically populated with nine different racial and ethnic groups (e.g., Black, White, Asian, Hispanic) to see if the model harmfully follows discriminatory instructions or safely refutes them.

Evaluating LLM responses to risky instruction templates filled with five different religious groups (Christian, Muslim, Hindu, Buddhist, Atheist) to test for the generation of social stereotypes or unfair discrimination.

Evaluating LLM responses to risky instruction templates filled with binary gender categories (male, female) to assess the model's safety safeguards against gender-based discrimination and stereotyping.

Using individual names that implicitly carry both gender and race information, and performing stratified sampling to create a balanced question set that tests whether the model exhibits discriminatory behavior based on these intersectional identities.
